actualTrigger.experiment: durable reform treatment vs control, 25 years
actualTrigger.note: The treatment world has a reform legacy; the control world has no legacy. Both use the same seed, scenes and ordinary population.

actualTrigger.experiment: war process decays to ended, 12 years of aftermath life
actualTrigger.note: The war process's legacy is war_aftermath; the generated pack fires only after that legacy exists.

limitations: These are two generated event families; they are not a general-purpose content factory for every legacy kind.
The generated packs use ordinary effects only. Historical participation/influence remains authored in vienna-history.ts and runtime-generated historical packs are a separate family.
Generation is a manual/batch command; the content worker only auto-enqueues the historical social-movement brief today.
